messages:
Evan H: Hi all - weird issue on my first week. My benefits portal shows my mailing address as my old place so I think my insurance card will go to the wrong house. Can someone change it? Also I had to stay in a hotel for 3 nights because my move delayed. Is that reimbursable?

Benefits Bot: Auto-note: address edits for benefits cards must be verified. Please confirm new address and attach a photo ID if address differs from your gov ID.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Evan! Quick answers: 1) We can update the mailing address for cards but we need a verification step (photo of ID + confirmation email). 2) Short-term hotel due to relocation can be reimbursed if it falls under your relocation allowance and you include manager approval.

Evan H: Thanks. My new address is 412 Willow St Apt 5, Portland OR 97205. I updated Workday but the benefits portal still shows old address. Do I need to send both?

Maya (People Ops): Please attach a photo of your driver's license (obscure SSN) and a copy of the lease or utility bill showing the new address to benefits@redwood.com. We will push the update to the insurer. Also cc your hiring manager so the hotel nights can be approved quickly.

Olga (Recruiter): Happy to approve the hotel nights for Evan; confirming manager approval here as well. Olga approves 3 nights (2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13).

Evan H: Great, uploaded DL and lease to benefits@redwood.com and cc'd Olga. Do I submit the hotel receipt to Expensify or benefits?

Juan (Payroll): Submit the hotel receipt in Expensify under "Relocation" if available. If not, email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "Relocation Hotel - Evan H - [date]" and attach receipt + Olga's approval. Note: receipts > $500 require prior approval; this is under that. Processing takes 1-2 payroll cycles.

Benefits Bot: Ticket created: BEN-2026-0789. We'll confirm address update and reimbursement status within 2 business days.

Evan H: Thanks team. One more tiny thing: do benefits cards ship expedited if we request due to gap? My old coverage ended 2026-03-09.

Maya (People Ops): If you have a coverage gap we can request expedited shipping from the insurer once address is verified and retroactive effective is approved. Please include the prior coverage end date and proof in your email and write "Expedite card shipping" in the subject line.

HR Bot: Note: payroll will reflect any retro benefits cost adjustments after benefits approval. If you need an employer letter for providers while card is pending, request it in the same email.

Evan H: Uploaded proof of prior coverage end date and asked for expedited shipping. Appreciate it everyone! :pray:

Benefits Bot: Confirmed documents received. BEN-2026-0789 updated. Expected reply by 2026-03-16.
